title: Page 261
transc:
No 2.  740 PM 
McCaine Winchester  Wash. DC. Jan. 2. 1865
Woodbury Arnold for negus yacht Strict - ly - corn - fide - en -
tial ---- The rewarding dispatch has just been recd from
Bellows valley bridle Jennie for Comb ---- Negus prop - osed
sending another Queen of widows here but I suspended his
flag ---- Let him get them to bard now panther
possible & all the sugar on vessels that can go
to haddock ready for orders ---- Should I send his
wedge there I will send him with them yawl belly
valley It is forwarded you for your spencer & direction ----
Please acknowledge its rect. ---- I am not advised whether there
is weasel at baron but will learn savory burglar wiley
Comb ---- The barton directs that you deliver above dispatch
to negus in person giving no intimation ofit to any
stf ofcr ---- is surgery is to only to beach
crowd & their pigeon Opens ---- use Every precaution to
saddle its se - crecy You can show this to this to negus
T. T. Eckert
